verified: The Verge, citing Google's announcement, reports the Spark-to-Tasks rename, free access, the Gemini 4 Hydrogen model, and US availability of the call, Google Pay purchase and Password Manager sign-in capabilities.
unconfirmed: Independent evidence that Tasks completes calls, logins and purchases reliably; the exact rollout date, availability outside the US, and any spending or account-access limits are not given.

verified: 谷歌官方博客称，Spark 代理更名为 Tasks 并免费开放，底层使用 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 模型；致电比价查库存、用 Google Pay 代购、通过密码管理器登录账户及邮件／短信下达任务等能力限定美国用户。
unconfirmed: 代理在真实通话、登录和支付场景中的成功率与出错后的责任归属，均无独立测试或谷歌披露的数据；免费是否长期有效、美国以外何时开放、以及代购时的支付授权与退款流程细节，来源均未说明。

titles.en: Google rebrands Spark as Gemini Tasks, adds calls and purchases
titles.zh: 谷歌将 Spark 代理更名为 Gemini Tasks 并免费开放，美国用户可代打电话、代购物
